findings: Producer gate was manifest-only and not verifier-enforced.
Public health returned only shared v106 identity and could not distinguish Formal.13 from Formal.14.
Formal.13 incident receipts were not tracked and bound.
Readiness CLI was not invoked by a bound deployment runner.
Expected commit remained caller-controlled and direct attempts could exceed the manifest bound.
Rollback accepted terminal labels without a durable terminalization receipt read-back.
Rollback receipt was replayable and abandoned_shoe_change was outside receipt coverage.
Capture-source exclusive fence and ingest RPC revoke did not span terminalization through rollback.

formal17Fix.scope: Canonical attested endpoint, single-use activation-bound rollback receipt, full non-Final receipt coverage and capture-source exclusive fence.
formal17Fix.gate: Runner has no URL override and uses the manifest/attestation-bound Render endpoint. Terminalizer acquires the capture-source exclusive lock, revokes Raw ingest, covers every non-Final issuance, records active v106 activation generation and nonce. Rollback requires an unconsumed matching-generation receipt, rechecks zero active Outbox, consumes the receipt and only then restores v105 ingest.

formal18Fix.scope: Public readiness refuses every HTTP redirect before identity evaluation.
formal18Fix.gate: The release-bound verifier requires redirect:error in the exact readiness implementation; a counterfeit responder reachable only through redirect cannot satisfy the two-probe identity gate.

formal19Fix.scope: Trusted signed-tag authorization, repository-bound producer starter, and database-owned activation generation.
formal19Fix.gate: The SSH-signed tag must be from the pinned release signer and bind the exact external-attestation SHA-256. The cutover runner rejects producer path overrides, rechecks HEAD/index tree and producer blob after readiness, then executes only the manifest-bound Git blob with post-start worker identity/health readback. Activation assigns a database-owned generation UUID; terminalization copies it, revokes both direct and fenced Raw ingest paths, and rollback requires exact generation plus post-activation receipt times. Rollback component package/build/strategy/protocol and ancestry are derived from exact Git commits rather than trusted manifest booleans.

formal20Fix.scope: Repository-external signer trust policy, production DB generation/ACL provenance gate, shared direct-Raw rollback barrier, and immutable worker image ID.

formal20Fix.databaseGate: Manifest/blob-bound pre/post producer gate binds expected Supabase project, migrations, sole Active v106 generation, ACL tuple, Raw barrier and bounded Outbox.
formal20Fix.rawBarrier: Direct inner RPC now acquires shared advisory barrier and runtime service_role cannot execute it; rollback restores fenced wrapper only.
